vote.question: On the Joint Resolution
vote.senate_document_text: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency of the Department of the Treasury relating to the review of applications under the Bank Merger Act.

object.title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency of the Department of the Treasury relating to the review of applications under the Bank Merger Act.
object.passage_action_text: Passed Senate without amendment by Yea-Nay Vote. 52 - 47. Record Vote Number: 237. (text: CR S2793)

text_binding.selection_reason: engrossed by the Senate on the vote date (es): the measure as passed

cra.agency: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency of the Department of the Treasury
cra.rule_title: the review of applications under the Bank Merger Act
cra.consequence_ref: Congressional Review Act, 5 U.S.C. 801(b): a rule disapproved by an enacted joint resolution shall not take effect (or shall not continue in effect) and may not be reissued in substantially the same form without subsequent statutory authorization.

receipt.heading_failure: If the resolution does not pass
receipt.yea_means: A Yea vote is a vote to pass the joint resolution in the Senate.
receipt.nay_means: A Nay vote is a vote against passing the joint resolution.

vote_result.statement: The Senate passed the joint resolution.

next_step.actual: The Senate passed the joint resolution. It next goes to the House.
